prompt: Compose one complete original 60-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: spare koto groove with spacious precise rhythmic gestures. Instruments: koto, muted synth bass, tight electronic drums, bamboo clicks. Tempo 110 BPM. Distinct motif: a dotted rhythmic question and short answer. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 35-second product-demo film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:58, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.
